description: This file defines the PlayerActivity class, which manages media playback using ExoPlayer within an Android application. It handles initializing and releasing the player, UI setup, immersive full-screen mode, and custom controls for a media player screen.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that plays media streams via ExoPlayer with immersive full-screen UI and custom controls.

methods.name: newIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to start PlayerActivity with specified media URL, title, and poster.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, reads intent extras, sets up UI, and prepares the player for playback.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Sets up the ExoPlayer instance, attaches listeners, and starts playback.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources when activity is paused or stopped.

methods.name: enterImmersiveMode
methods.description: Enables full-screen immersive mode, hiding system bars.

methods.name: wireControllerButtons
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to custom control buttons in the player UI.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Finds and assigns click listeners to control buttons if they exist.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initialize the player on SDK >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method to re-initialize player if needed and re-apply immersive mode.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method to release player and revert UI adjustments when activity pauses.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases player on SDK >=24 when activity stops.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back press to release player and transition smoothly.
